question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id, SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
  GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
qualifying_cities AS (
  SELECT cust_city
  FROM city_sales
  PIVOT (SUM(total_sales) FOR calendar_quarter_id IN (1772 as sales_2019_q4, 1776 as sales_2020_q4))
  WHERE sales_2019_q4 > 0
    AND (sales_2020_q4 - sales_2019_q4) * 100.0 / NULLIF(sales_2019_q4, 0) >= 20
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_id, SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products p WHERE p.prod_id = s.prod_id)
  GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
quarter_totals AS (
  SELECT calendar_quarter_id, SUM(product_sales) as total_sales
  FROM product_quarter_sales
  GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),
product_shares AS (
  SELECT p.prod_id, p.calendar_quarter_id, p.product_sales, q.total_sales as quarter_total,
         p.product_sales * 100.0 / q.total_sales as share_pct
  FROM product_quarter_sales p
  JOIN quarter_totals q ON p.calendar_quarter_id = q.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_total_sales AS (
  SELECT prod_id, SUM(product_sales) as total_sales
  FROM product_quarter_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id
),
top_20_pct AS (
  SELECT prod_id, total_sales,
         NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as tile
  FROM product_total_sales
),
top_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id
  FROM top_20_pct
  WHERE tile = 1
),
product_share_pivot AS (
  SELECT prod_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN share_pct END) as share_2019,
         MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN share_pct END) as share_2020
  FROM product_shares
  WHERE prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_products)
  GROUP BY prod_id
)
SELECT ps.prod_id, p.prod_name, share_2019, share_2020,
       ABS(share_2020 - share_2019) as pct_point_change
FROM product_share_pivot ps
JOIN products p ON ps.prod_id = p.prod_id
ORDER BY pct_point_change ASC
